unknown-finish.why: The one deliberate change (decision 2026-11-13 §12): `finish: hallo  # note` renders with `hallo` and lint-core said nothing, because its bare-name pattern failed on the trailing comment. The port reads the value through the shared scalar rule, as the engine does. The source is test/unit/authoring/squadra-front-matter-registers.test.js, which pins exactly this.

The same source as the lint entry: Squadra fixes `hallo` to `halo` where lint-core had no finding to fix. Matched by the recording's index, so a change to the lint tests' order makes this entry stale and the run red, which is the point: the entry is re-checked, not carried.

That is not a line of the source, so its Fix all cannot place the fix and leaves the deck unchanged. The port fixes the value in place.
